import math

def main():
    x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
    
    EPS = 1e-9
    minError = 1e18
    numerator = 0
    denominator = 0
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        target = x * i / y
        tx = int(math.floor(target + 0.5 - EPS))
        
        currentError = abs(x / y - tx / i)
        
        if currentError < minError:
            minError = currentError
            numerator = tx
            denominator = i
    
    print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
